q.en: While acting as President, the Vice-President is:

options.en: Not paid the salary of the Chairman of the Rajya Sabha

explanation.en: While acting as President, the Vice-President does not receive the Chairman's salary.
explanation.as: ৰাষ্ট্ৰপতি হিচাপে কাৰ্যনিৰ্বাহ কৰোঁতে উপ-ৰাষ্ট্ৰপতিয়ে অধ্যক্ষৰ দৰমহা নাপায়।
